title: Support accessing multiple notes through one widget
line: One Sticky Note widget, on the desktop or behind a panel icon, can now hold several notes and flip between them.
explanation: The Sticky Note widget stored a single note id in its config and loaded exactly one note, so the only way to keep several notes was to add one widget per note, which is clumsy in a panel. The change adds a noteIds list to the widget's config (noteId stays the shown note, so existing widgets keep working unchanged) and loads every note of the widget once. The toolbar gets an Add Note button and, when there is more than one note, previous/next arrows with an "n/total" label; the delete button deletes only the current note when there are several (with the same confirmation as before), and removing the widget trashes all of its notes.

commits.message:
applets/notes: allow one Sticky Note widget to hold several notes

Each widget could only show a single note, so keeping a few notes behind
one panel icon meant adding a widget for each. The toolbar now has a
button to add a note and arrows to move between the notes of the widget.

BUG: 489512

media.caption: Desktop Sticky Note on master: one note per widget, the toolbar has no way to add another.
Panel Sticky Note popup on master: same, one note only.
Desktop Sticky Note with the fix: a second note added from the new + button, arrows and 2/2 to move between them.
Panel Sticky Note popup with the fix holding three notes (3/3).
Panel popup: next/previous wrap around, Add Note inserts a new note, then moving back and forth between them.
